tasks.description: Remove duplicate/unused imports, add missing imports, and ensure top-level ordering in core modules.
comments: Removed duplicate/unused imports in core entrypoints and normalized ordering in `core/src/personal_assistant/main.py` and `core/src/personal_assistant/agent.py`.
Added missing standard-lib imports in `core/src/personal_assistant/client.py` (shutil/tempfile/time).
Effect: cleaner import blocks, fewer runtime import errors, no behavior change.

tasks.description: Add/adjust type hints for clarity; small refactors without behavior changes.
comments: Added type hints to `VideoAgent` methods and core client methods, plus return types in `core/src/personal_assistant/main.py`.
Introduced typed config helpers in `core/src/personal_assistant/config.py`.
Effect: clearer APIs and improved static analysis without altering runtime logic.

tasks.description: Extract config helpers / shared utilities if needed to reduce clutter in main.
comments: Moved `_locate_config`, `load_config`, `resolve_arg`, and `resolve_output_path` into `core/src/personal_assistant/config.py`.
Updated `core/src/personal_assistant/main.py` to import helpers from the new module.
Effect: slimmer `main.py` and shared config logic without changing behavior.

tasks.description: Normalize imports in UI modules and add missing ones.
comments: Normalized import ordering in `ui/src/personal_assistant_ui/agent_helper.py`, `ui/src/personal_assistant_ui/config.py`, and `ui/src/personal_assistant_ui/views/settings.py`.
Updated UI settings view to import config helper from `personal_assistant.config`.
Effect: consistent import style and shared config usage across UI.

tasks.description: Add type hints and minor cleanup in UI agent helper.
comments: Added type hints and explicit return types in `ui/src/personal_assistant_ui/agent_helper.py`.
Annotated config dictionaries and async return tuple for better clarity.
Effect: improved readability and type checking without changing async flow.

tasks.description: Align devtools behavior across core/UI/workspace, naming, and error handling.
comments: Refactored core and UI devtools to run command lists via a shared `_run_commands` helper.
Kept the same command sequence across core/UI/workspace, only differing by paths and mypy flags.
Effect: consistent output and easier maintenance for check runners.

tasks.task: ui: fix ruff violations from checks
tasks.description: Resolve ruff violations reported by video-agent-checks (E701, F841) in UI views.
comments: Split one-line `if` statements in `ui/src/personal_assistant_ui/views/events.py` and `ui/src/personal_assistant_ui/views/transcribe.py` into multi-line blocks.
Removed unused `applied_name` variable in `ui/src/personal_assistant_ui/views/settings.py`.
Effect: ruff E701/F841 violations resolved without changing behavior.

tasks.task: format: apply ruff format across core and ui
tasks.description: Run ruff formatter to satisfy format checks in core/ui sources.
comments: Ran `ruff format` across `core/src` and `ui/src` to normalize formatting.
Effect: format checks now pass for previously flagged files.

tasks.task: core: fix mypy optional typing in CLI args
tasks.description: Align Typer CLI argument types with optional defaults and add assertions for mypy.
comments: Updated CLI parameter annotations in `core/src/personal_assistant/main.py` to use optional types where defaults are `None`.
Added explicit `assert ... is not None` after required checks so mypy understands runtime guarantees.
Effect: mypy assignment errors resolved for CLI arg handling.

tasks.description: Replace python -m pip check with uv pip check to avoid missing pip module errors.
comments: Swapped `python -m pip check` to `uv pip check` in core and UI devtools.
Effect: check runner no longer fails when pip isn't installed in the uv runtime.

tasks.task: docs: align AGENTS pip check command
tasks.description: Update AGENTS.md equivalent commands to use uv pip check.
comments: Updated AGENTS.md to list `uv pip check` in the equivalent command list.
Effect: documentation matches the updated check runner behavior.

tasks.description: Fix CI install step to avoid editable install of workspace root and install core/ui packages directly.
comments: Updated `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to install `core[dev]` and `ui[dev]` instead of the workspace root.
Adjusted ruff/mypy/compileall paths to target `core/src` and `ui/src`.
Effect: CI no longer attempts to build the workspace root and should pass package discovery.
